article.title_en: MUNA Social Service An-Namirah: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: MUNA Social Service An-Namirah es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, en la avenida Pitkin. Atiende los lunes, de 2pm a 3pm.
article.summary_en: MUNA Social Service An-Namirah is a food pantry in Brooklyn, on Pitkin Avenue. It is open on Mondays, from 2pm to 3pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 2135 Pitkin Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11207.
Abre los lunes de 2pm a 3pm, según el horario publicado.
La despensa atiende solo el primer y tercer lunes de cada mes.
Puede llamar al (212) 920-6202 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 2135 Pitkin Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11207.
It is open Mondays from 2pm to 3pm, according to the posted hours.
The pantry runs only on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of each month.
You can call (212) 920-6202 to ask before you go.
visit_tips_es: Recuerde que la despensa solo abre el primer y tercer lunes del mes.
El horario es corto, de 2pm a 3pm, así que planifique su visita.
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; llame al (212) 920-6202 para preguntar.
visit_tips_en: Remember the pantry is open only on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of the month.
The hours are short, 2pm to 3pm, so plan your visit.
It is not listed what food is given or if there are requirements; call (212) 920-6202 to ask.
